situation: A software business renewing its largest customer, a regional distributor.
complication: The customer's usage has fallen sharply ahead of renewal, and reporting causes most of their tickets.
key_question: How should we approach the largest customer's renewal given falling usage?

work.title: Check-in email to the customer's operations lead
work.for: The customer's operations lead, email for the customer success manager to approve before sending
body: Subject: A quick check-in before your renewal
Hi, I hope things are going well at your end. With your renewal coming up next quarter, I wanted to check in on how the platform is working for your team.
Looking at your account, fewer people have been logging in this year, and several recent support requests were about reporting. I'd like to help with both.
Could we set up a short call? I can walk through usage by team and run a reporting session for your managers, showing the reports your team asks about most.
If it would help, we can also review whether your seat count still fits how your team works today.
Let me know a time that suits you. Best regards, your customer success team.
